SUBMARINE ADJUSTMENT INSTRUCTIONS LEAF SWITCHES AND CAMS All leaf blade switches must be adjusted to meet the below specification. TARGET PANEL (See Sketch “A”) PAGE 4 1 With gears off and chain not engaged with motor sprocket, position sinking ship carriage in center of panel (12-5/8 from inside of frame). Assemble chain as shown in sketch around motor, gear drive and idler sprockets. Adjust chain tension per sketch at right idler. Attach 90 tooth gear to long crank shaft and tighten set screw on shaft flat. Note, when assembling all gears, be sure they are positioned against the shoulder of the shaft. With the long crank positioned vertically down, engage the 12 tooth drive pinion with the 90 tooth gear, Before engaging, rotate the pinion until one of it’s set screws is perpendicu- lar to the flat on shaft. Tighten both set screws securely. With the short crank vertically down, engage the 48 tooth gear and tighten set screws. The assembly should now look like the sketch with both cranks vertically down and the sinking ship carriage in the center of panel. Caution: This adjustment must be exactly like the sketch or else the links and levers will interfere causing machine damage. The two ends of stroke roller leaf switches must be adjusted for 17” carriage travel. Caution: Do not try to move the carriage, links or gears manually. Only use the motor (12 V.D.C.). Target ship height adjustments are as follows. All heights are from the blue (ocean) plastic to the highest point on ship. Attach meter leads to G-B and BRN wires on adjustment terminal strip. Rotate conveyor servo pot shaft until meter reads half of value measured in step #7. Tighten two (2) set screws on potentiometer drive gear, Rotate pot shafts 1 and 2 to approximate center of pot travel. Connect jack J-5 at game logic board. Disconnect jack at periscope servo pot. Loosen 2 lower set screws holding periscope pot shaft and remove pot and P.C. assembly. Measure resistance between pins 4 and 6 on periscope P.C. jack. Attach meter to pins 5 and 7 on periscope P.C. jack and rotate servo pot shaft until meter reads half the value measured in step 15. Sight periscope cross-hair at approximate center of target panel. Replace servo pot assembly and tighten set screw being careful not to move periscope sight line from center of target panel. Replace periscope jack. Position adjustment switches 7 and 8 (located on motherboard) in “OFF” position (align- ment mode). Apply power to game by putting safety switch in “ON” position. Aim periscope to left extremity and press trigger button. If torpedo path does not align with cross-hairs in periscope, rotate pot shaft 2 (on torpedo conveyor unit assembly) until they do. Aim periscope to right extremity and press trigger button. If torpedo path does not align with cross-hairs in periscope, rotate pot shaft 1 (on torpedo conveyor unit assembly) until they do.
